services.name: Tennis Lessons
services.desc: are taught by the club’s tennis professional, Katya Pomier, who has been the head tennis pro at the club since 2014. Originally from Russia, Coach Katya has been playing tennis since she was 5 years old. She attended the University of Kansas on a full tennis scholarship and played singles and doubles her four years. Coach Katya teaches all age groups and is on the court almost every day of the week instructing students. She offers quick start programs where kids use smaller rackets, smaller court and low compression balls depending on their age, level and ability. She will always make sure your child learns the strokes, basics of the game and technique while having a blast.

blurb: The Memorial Forest Club is a family-friendly, members-only club established in the 1950s. We are located on Memorial Drive in the heart of the Memorial area of Houston. We have tennis courts, a volleyball and pickleball court, a basketball mini-court, clubhouse, three pools and a summer snack bar.
